title: Build Derived State and Watchers
short_description: Build cached values and watchers on top of an effect system with a scheduler.
description: The starter includes ref, effect, track, trigger, and stop so you can focus on derived behavior.
Implement pedagogical versions of computed, watch, and watchEffect that invalidate caches, compare sources, and clean up stale work.
instructions: Complete computed(getter) with lazy evaluation, caching, a dirty flag, and consumer notification when invalidated.
Complete watch(source, callback, options) so it observes a ref or getter, preserves oldValue, and supports immediate.
Run cleanup registered by watch before the next callback and when the watcher stops.
Complete watchEffect(fn) so it discovers dependencies while running and cleans up before repeating.
Make the returned handles stop the inner effect and release pending cleanup.
Keep resetObservation working so every test starts with empty dependencies.

hints.title: Computed cache
hints.body: Store `cachedValue` and begin with `dirty = true`. The `.value` getter should only run the runner when the cache is dirty.

hints.title: Invalidate without recomputing
hints.body: The computed scheduler sets `dirty = true` and calls `trigger(computedRef, "value")`. It should not run the getter directly.

hints.title: Watch job
hints.body: Create a lazy effect for the source. Its scheduler runs a job that obtains `newValue`, compares it, cleans up previous work, and calls the callback.

hints.title: Automatic cleanup
hints.body: In `watchEffect`, run the stored cleanup inside the wrapper before calling `fn(onCleanup)` again. The handle should also clean up before using `stop`.
